Locators are printed page numbers (266-274). Australian CSIRO life-cycle assessment of iron ore (open-cut), bauxite (open-cut) and copper concentrate (underground + concentrator). Main file: Table 2 inventory per t ore, final energy only, by stage (diesel kg/t, electricity kWh/t) plus per-mine overall diesel (MJ/t) and electricity; stage technologies are named with archetype keys where the equipment matches. Table 3 embodied (primary) energy and GWP per stage, and Table 4 (US DOE 2007 practical-minimum energies, primary) are in other-values because they are primary/life-cycle figures. Fig. 4-9 chart values not loaded. Explosives (ANFO), water, tailings, reagents, rail and port in other-values. No costs. Diesel is given in kg/t ore (heating value not stated; the overall MJ/t figures imply about 39.7 MJ/kg).
Table 3 copper rows are per t concentrate while Table 2 is per t ore (16.2 t ore/t concentrate). Table 2 bauxite drilling diesel is an assumption copied from iron ore.
